_note: Cited public values and forms for compressible flow; our own numbers are computed, never typed. See SOURCES.md.

naca1135_table1_subsonic.what: Table I, subsonic flow, gamma = 7/5 (report p. 633): rows M = 0.50, 0.55, 0.60
naca1135_table1_subsonic.source: Ames Research Staff, 'Equations, Tables, and Charts for Compressible Flow', NACA Report 1135 (1953), Table I
naca1135_table1_subsonic.how_obtained: page rendered at 4x and read as an image; typed by hand; every entry then reproduced by our functions

naca1135_table2_supersonic.what: Table II, supersonic flow, gamma = 7/5 (report p. 634): rows M = 1.60, 1.65, 1.70, 2.00, 2.05, 2.10; beta = sqrt(M^2 - 1), q = dynamic pressure, nu = Prandtl-Meyer angle, mu = Mach angle (degrees), subscript 2 = behind a normal shock, t = total (stagnation)
naca1135_table2_supersonic.source: Ames Research Staff, 'Equations, Tables, and Charts for Compressible Flow', NACA Report 1135 (1953), Table II
naca1135_table2_supersonic.how_obtained: page rendered at 3.2x and read as an image; typed by hand; every entry then reproduced by our functions

naca1135_forms.what: equations of the report, by its own equation numbers; xi = p2/p1, theta = shock-wave angle, delta = deflection (our sigma, delta), tilde u and tilde v = velocity components normal and parallel to the shock
naca1135_forms.eq_111: pt2/pt1 = exp(-Delta s/R) = xi^(-1/(gamma-1)) {[(gamma+1) xi + (gamma-1)] / [(gamma-1) xi + (gamma+1)]}^(gamma/(gamma-1))
naca1135_forms.eq_124: u1~ u2~ = a*^2 - (gamma-1)/(gamma+1) v~^2   (Prandtl's relation for an oblique shock)
naca1135_forms.eq_132: M2^2 = {(gamma+1)^2 M1^4 sin^2(theta) - 4 (M1^2 sin^2(theta) - 1)(gamma M1^2 sin^2(theta) + 1)} / {[2 gamma M1^2 sin^2(theta) - (gamma-1)] [(gamma-1) M1^2 sin^2(theta) + 2]}
naca1135_forms.eq_137: V2^2/V1^2 = 1 - 4 (M1^2 sin^2(theta) - 1)(gamma M1^2 sin^2(theta) + 1) / [(gamma+1)^2 M1^4 sin^2(theta)]
naca1135_forms.eq_139b: tan(delta) = [M1^2 sin(2 theta) - 2 cot(theta)] / [2 + M1^2 (gamma + cos(2 theta))]
naca1135_forms.eq_142: pt2/pt1 = {(gamma+1) M1^2 sin^2(theta) / [(gamma-1) M1^2 sin^2(theta) + 2]}^(gamma/(gamma-1)) {(gamma+1) / [2 gamma M1^2 sin^2(theta) - (gamma-1)]}^(1/(gamma-1))
naca1135_forms.eq_147: Delta s/R = [1/(gamma-1)] Delta s/c_v = 2 gamma/(3 (gamma+1)^2) m^3 - 2 gamma^2/(gamma+1)^3 m^4 + ..., m = M1^2 sin^2(theta) - 1
naca1135_forms.eq_167: sin^2(theta*) = {(gamma+1) M1^2 - (3-gamma) + sqrt((gamma+1)[(gamma+1) M1^4 - 2(3-gamma) M1^2 + (gamma+9)])} / (4 gamma M1^2)   (M2 = 1)
naca1135_forms.eq_168: sin^2(theta_dmax) = {(gamma+1) M1^2 - 4 + sqrt((gamma+1)[(gamma+1) M1^4 + 8(gamma-1) M1^2 + 16])} / (4 gamma M1^2)   (maximum deflection)

eq_170.form: delta_max ~ 4 (M1^2 - 1)^(3/2) / (3 sqrt(3) (gamma+1) M1^2)   (M1 close to 1, radians)

naca1135_forms.wedge_limit_form: the bow wave is attached for a wedge of semivertex angle less than asin(1/gamma) = 45.6 deg for gamma = 7/5
naca1135_forms.expansion_series: p2/p1 = 1 - gamma M1^2/sqrt(M1^2-1) (Dnu) + gamma M1^2 [(gamma+1) M1^4 - 4 (M1^2-1)] / [4 (M1^2-1)^2] (Dnu)^2 - ...   (Dnu in radians)
naca1135_forms.source: Ames Research Staff, 'Equations, Tables, and Charts for Compressible Flow', NACA Report 1135 (1953), report pp. 620-626
naca1135_forms.how_obtained: pages rendered and read as images (equations transcribed by hand)

normal_shock_tables.what: normal-shock table for gamma = 1.4: M1, M2, p2/p1, rho2/rho1, T2/T1, p02/p01
normal_shock_tables.how_obtained: page fetched and the four rows extracted; the M1 = 2 row agrees with NACA Report 1135, Table II

choked_flow.what: critical pressure ratio p*/p0 = (2/(gamma+1))^(gamma/(gamma-1)) ('p* = 0.528 p0' for gamma = 1.4) and the page's table of minimum upstream/downstream pressure ratios for choked flow (the reciprocal); mass flow mdot = C_d A sqrt(gamma rho0 P0 (2/(gamma+1))^((gamma+1)/(gamma-1)))

fanno_flow.what: adiabatic constant-area flow with friction, ratios to the sonic state of the same process
fanno_flow.differential: dM^2/M^2 = gamma M^2/(1 - M^2) (1 + (gamma-1)/2 M^2) 4 f dx/D_h
fanno_flow.length: 4 f L*/D_h = (1 - M^2)/(gamma M^2) + (gamma+1)/(2 gamma) ln[ M^2 / ( (2/(gamma+1)) (1 + (gamma-1)/2 M^2) ) ]
fanno_flow.ratios: with B = (2/(gamma+1))(1 + (gamma-1)/2 M^2): p/p* = 1/(M sqrt(B)), rho/rho* = sqrt(B)/M, T/T* = 1/B, V/V* = M/sqrt(B), p0/p0* = B^((gamma+1)/(2(gamma-1)))/M
fanno_flow.entropy: Delta s/c_p = ln[ M^((gamma-1)/gamma) B^(-(gamma+1)/(2 gamma)) ]
fanno_flow.how_obtained: page fetched and the formulas read

rayleigh_flow.what: frictionless constant-area flow with heat exchange, ratios to the sonic state of the same process
rayleigh_flow.ratios: p/p* = (gamma+1)/(1 + gamma M^2), rho/rho* = (1 + gamma M^2)/((gamma+1) M^2), T/T* = (gamma+1)^2 M^2/(1 + gamma M^2)^2, v/v* = (gamma+1) M^2/(1 + gamma M^2), T0/T0* = 2 (gamma+1) M^2 (1 + (gamma-1)/2 M^2)/(1 + gamma M^2)^2, p0/p0* = (gamma+1)/(1 + gamma M^2) [ (2/(gamma+1)) (1 + (gamma-1)/2 M^2) ]^(gamma/(gamma-1))
rayleigh_flow.statement: for subsonic flow the maximum of H occurs at M = 0.845; between there and M = 1 heat is added but T/T* decreases
rayleigh_flow.how_obtained: page fetched and read (the page states 0.845 without the formula 1/sqrt(gamma); gamma = 1.4 is implied by its charts)
